briefdescription.para: Concrete Ring wrapper around an owned FreeAlgebraQuotient (the quotient counterpart of M2FreeAlgebra).

detaileddescription.para: Holds a reference to the ambient M2FreeAlgebra plus a std::unique_ptr<FreeAlgebraQuotient> carrying the Groebner-basis-defined quotient. create(F, GB, maxdeg) is the factory: it accepts the engine Matrix* GB of defining relations and an optional maxdeg cap (-1 means compute a complete GB), wires up the underlying FreeAlgebraQuotient, and lifts it into the engine's Ring hierarchy.
